entry.title: Fix noun mutation losing singular_only guard, producing "the musics a…
entry.content:
Fix noun mutation losing singular_only guard, producing "the musics are old"

mutateDimension's 'noun' case swapped to a new noun but kept the
current exercise's number unchecked. A plural mutation chain that
happened to swap onto a singular_only noun (musica, acqua, cibo...)
inherited the plural, producing nonsense like "the musics are old" for
an uncountable noun. Force singular when the incoming noun is
singular_only, matching the guard the 'number' dimension already had.

Added a deterministic regression test (pins the noun pool to
[gatto, musica] so the swap can't land anywhere else) in test_engine.html.

entry.title: Fix inaccurate ginocchio/labbro glosses in hetero-gender-plurals doc
entry.content:
Fix inaccurate ginocchio/labbro glosses in hetero-gender-plurals doc

Verified against Accademia della Crusca and Treccani. Two errors found:
- labbro: i labbri was glossed as "individual lips, jar lips" -- wrong,
  it never means lips at all, only wound edges or a container/perimeter
  rim.
- ginocchio: doc claimed a firm "knees together" vs "individual knees"
  split matching braccio/dito/osso. Crusca says there's no precise rule
  here; the two plurals overlap and le ginocchia is just the more
  common form, not a real semantic distinction.

Also flags ciglio/grido/muro/uovo/sopracciglio as carried over from an
earlier pass and not yet independently verified.

entry.title: Fix possessive article drop: kinship rule, not just nuclear family
entry.content:
Fix possessive article drop: kinship rule, not just nuclear family

The article-drop rule for possessives + singular family nouns was
scoped to a nuclear_family tag on only 6 nouns (madre, padre,
fratello, sorella, marito, moglie). The real Italian rule covers
singular unmodified kinship nouns generally — extended family too
(mia zia, mio zio, mio nonno, mio cugino). Renamed the tag to
kinship_article_drop, added the missing kinship nouns tagged
accordingly, and fixed a dangling ruleId (possessive_nuclear had no
matching entry in rules.json, so Explain showed nothing for these).

entry.content:
